name: Space Mine Raider
summary:
Space Mine Raider is a mining and bullet hell incremental game with a focus on strong power progression and combat. Warp in, mine resources, fight enemies and bosses, and extract with your spoils to upgrade your ship.
Start by mining small asteroids and blasting basic enemies, then watch your power snowball.
Earn research points to traverse the prestige tree for permanent upgrades that carry into every future run.
Every new map brings new hazards, enemies, and bosses to overcome.
